techArticle.headline: Connect Manilo to ChatGPT, Claude & Cursor — MCP Expense Tracker
techArticle.description: How to connect the Manilo expense tracker to ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, or any AI assistant that speaks Model Context Protocol.

howtoChatgpt.name: How to connect Manilo to ChatGPT
howtoChatgpt.description: Connect the Manilo expense tracker to ChatGPT in two steps.

steps.name: Connect Manilo to ChatGPT
steps.text: Open the Manilo app in ChatGPT and click Connect.

steps.name: Follow the instructions
steps.text: Sign in with Apple, Google, or email and grant access. Then mention Manilo in any chat.

howtoClaude.name: How to connect Manilo to Claude
howtoClaude.description: Add the Manilo expense tracker to Claude as a custom MCP connector.

steps.name: Open connector settings
steps.text: In claude.ai or Claude Desktop, go to Settings → Connectors → Add custom connector.

steps.name: Add and sign in
steps.text: Click Add, sign in with Apple, Google, or email, then enable Manilo from the connectors menu in any chat.

howtoCursor.name: How to connect Manilo to Cursor
howtoCursor.description: Install the Manilo MCP server in Cursor with one click.

steps.name: Add Manilo to Cursor
steps.text: Use the one-click install link, or add https://api.manilo.app/mcp to mcp.json.

steps.name: Follow the instructions
steps.text: Click Install when Cursor opens, then complete the sign-in in your browser.

prompts.title: What you can ask
prompts.sub: Every answer is computed from your own data — not an estimate.

items.q: What did I spend on coffee last month?
items.a: Totals by category over any date range.

items.q: Add a €12 lunch at Pret to my Wise account from yesterday.
items.a: Parses merchant, amount, currency, and date.

items.q: Transfer 200 EUR from Wise Personal to Cash.
How does my April spending compare to March?
items.a: Multi-period comparison in your primary currency.

items.q: Find every transaction over €100 in May.
Show my top 5 categories this quarter.
What's my Santander balance right now?
items.a: Live balance — same formula as the mobile app.

items.q: Reconcile Santander to 616 EUR — my bank app shows that.
items.a: One-shot adjustment to match an external figure.

capabilities.title: What Manilo can do once connected
capabilities.sub: The MCP server exposes 30+ tools to your assistant.

read.title: Read everything
read.body: Accounts, transactions, categories, budgets, groups, and tags.

edit.title: Add & edit
edit.body: Transactions, accounts, categories, budgets, and recurring rules.

move.title: Move money
move.body: Transfers between accounts, including cross-currency with FX.

convert.title: Convert currencies
convert.body: Live ECB rates; dashboard totals in your primary currency.

receipts.title: Handle receipts
receipts.body: Attach from a public URL and fetch signed download links.

reconcile.title: Balance & reconcile
reconcile.body: Live account balances and one-shot reconciliation against your bank.

scope.title: Sees only what you ask about
scope.body: The assistant gets the data your question needs. We don't push your full ledger to Anthropic or OpenAI on connection.

password.title: Your password stays yours
password.body: You sign in on Manilo's own consent page with Apple, Google, or email. The assistant never sees your password.

disconnect.title: Disconnect any time
disconnect.body: Remove the connector in your client's settings — Claude, ChatGPT, or any other. Revoking access takes effect immediately.
